intro_md: 🎧 **10 min.** Nam sees the bike notice (you read it earlier) and **phones Dave**. Learn five phone chunks, then hear them in a real call. Everything you hear is new.

parts.title: Phone call: the blue bike
parts.md:
![Nam calls Dave](data/img/w1/d14-bike-call.webp)

**Five phone chunks** (you will hear them in the call):

| Phrase | 🖼️ Picture it (literal) | So it means… |
|---|---|---|
| *Is it still available?* | a hand holds a shop door – is anything left inside? | Can I still buy it? Has nobody taken it? |
| *How much are you asking for it?* | a seller holds up a price card and you ask about the number | What is the price? |
| *Can I come and have a look?* | you walk to the door and look closely with your eyes | Can I visit and see it? |
| *come round* | you walk **round** the corner and arrive at a friend's front door | visit someone at their home |
| *I'll take it* | your hand picks the thing up from the shelf | I decide to buy it |

💡 *Examples:* Is the **flat** still available? · How much are you asking for the **piano**? · Can I come and have a look **tomorrow**? · Come round **for tea** on Friday. · It's perfect – I'll take it.

**Train your ears – the words are hidden at first:**
1. 👂 **Listen without the words.** Just follow. Missed a word? Keep going – the next sentence often explains it.
2. 👂 **Listen again**, still without the words. You'll catch more.
3. 📄 **Show transcript** – listen + read. **Tap any line** you missed to hear just that part again.
4. 👂 **Hide it** and listen one last time.

listen.text: Hello, is that Dave? I'm calling about the blue bike on the café noticeboard.
It is, yes. Nobody's phoned today, so you're the first.
Great. How much are you asking for it?
Sixty pounds. It's a good bike. I've looked after it well.
Is everything working? I don't know much about bikes.
The brakes are brand new, and the tyres are fine.
But I should tell you, the bell is broken. It only makes a little noise.
That's okay. Fifty pounds would be better for me, because of the bell.
Hmm. All right, fifty. But only if you come today.
Can I come and have a look at four o'clock?
Yes, four is fine. Come round to number twelve, Church Lane.
Twelve, Church Lane. How will I know which house it is?
It's the one with the green door. You can't miss it.
Perfect. If it's as good as you say, I'll take it. See you at four!

parts.title: Quick check + how was it?
parts.md: A few quick questions – tap an answer, you see right away if it's right. Then tell me how much you understood, ask me anything below, and 📤 **Submit**.

questions.q: What is wrong with the bike?
How will Nam know Dave's house?
options: It is next to the church
It has a blue bike outside

check.why: Dave says: *It's the one with the green door.*

questions.q: How much did you understand? Write a number, e.g. 80
